impact_summary.value: 503B 요건 미충족으로 해당 조제 의약품은 FDA 승인, 적절한 사용법 표시 및 의약품 공급망 보안법 요건의 면제 대상이 아닙니다. 무균 조제 관리 결함도 제품 오염 위험을 높입니다.

evidence.quote: Because your compounded drug products have not met all of the conditions of section 503B, they are not eligible for the exemptions in that section from the FDA approval requirements of section 505, the requirement under section 502(f)(1) that labeling bear adequate directions for use, and the Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements described in section 582 of the FDCA.

evidence.quote: FDA strongly recommends that your management undertake a comprehensive assessment of operations, including facility design, procedures, personnel, processes, maintenance, materials, and systems. A third party consultant with relevant sterile drug manufacturing expertise should assist you in conducting this comprehensive evaluation.
